'''Tainted Rune''' is provided as an objective for {{questlong|Alliance|1|Tainted Rune (quest)|Tainted Rune|race=dwarf|class=warlock}}.

==Contains==
{{Book||content=
ATTENTION:

Remain silent! Don't look around at anyone! Someone could be watching you this very moment.

My name is Thorrin Darkgrovel, <name>. I train those willing to seek knowledge and greater power from... worlds beyond. I see you have shown interest in magic that surpasses that of the infantile [[Azurestone Order]]. Fret not, I've been asked to get in touch with you discretely and inform you that I can train you further in a real form of magic.

When you can, come find me in the back of Anvilmar.

-Thorrin Darkgrovel, Warlock Trainer
}}
